headline: Interviews of superintendent finalist Andrew Bott covered budgets, equity, and family input.
summary: Andrew Bott, a finalist for superintendent, answered questions from members and Mayor Pangallo. Topics included budgeting, support for struggling students, and what schools should look like ten years from now.
